lines.cap: The richest people on Earth are quietly digging holes. In New Zealand. In Hawaii. In old missile silos. What do they know?
lines.say: The richest people on Earth are quietly digging holes. In New Zealand. In Hawaii. In old missile silos. What do they know?

lines.cap: Peter Thiel became a New Zealand citizen after spending just twelve days there. Nobody found out for six years.
lines.say: Peter Thiel became a New Zealand citizen after spending just twelve days there. Nobody found out for six years.

lines.cap: In Kansas, a nuclear missile silo became luxury doomsday condos. Pool. Cinema. Climbing wall. Millions per apartment.
lines.say: In Kansas, a nuclear missile silo became luxury doomsday condos. Pool. Cinema. Climbing wall. Millions per apartment.

lines.cap: Mark Zuckerberg's Hawaii ranch reportedly has a five thousand square foot underground shelter.
lines.say: Mark Zuckerberg's Hawaii ranch reportedly has a five thousand square foot underground shelter.

lines.cap: A LinkedIn co-founder guessed over half of Silicon Valley billionaires have apocalypse insurance.
lines.say: A LinkedIn co-founder guessed over half of Silicon Valley billionaires have apocalypse insurance.

lines.cap: Then a writer was paid to advise five billionaires. Their real question? After the world ends, how do we stop our own guards from turning on us?
lines.say: Then a writer was paid to advise five billionaires. Their real question? After the world ends, how do we stop our own guards from turning on us?

lines.cap: His answer: be nice to them. Now.
lines.say: His answer: be nice to them. Now.

lines.cap: Tag the friend you'd let in your bunker. Because, the richest people on Earth
lines.say: Tag the friend you'd let in your bunker. Because, the richest people on Earth
